freezerEnclosures.name: Commercial Kitchen Walk-In Storage Freezer (-18°C / 0°F, 12' x 10' x 8', R-32 Polyurethane)
freezerEnclosures.description: Standard high-traffic restaurant kitchen walk-in freezer holding inventory; equipped with 3 fans on an overhead evaporator coil and magnetic perimeter compression gaskets.

freezerEnclosures.name: High-Velocity Commercial Blast Freezer (-30°C / -22°F, Industrial High-CFM Airflow)
freezerEnclosures.description: Rapid cryo-reduction blast freezer engineered for rapid core temperature pull-down in commissary catering; high air velocity creates severe wind-chill acceleration.

freezerEnclosures.name: Distribution Cold Storage Pallet Vault (-25°C / -13°F, 24' x 20' Heavy-Duty Egress Door)
freezerEnclosures.description: Heavy commercial distribution cold vault with large surface area door; vacuum holding force under door closure can exceed 2,200 Newtons if pressure equalization port fails.

freezerEnclosures.name: Fast-Casual Compact Walk-In Box (-18°C / 0°F, 8' x 6' x 7.5', High Kitchen Humidity 75% RH)
freezerEnclosures.description: Tight back-of-house box situated directly adjacent to dishwashing station; severe ambient humidity ingress drives rapid ice bridge formation across cold metal contact faces.

freezerEnclosures.name: Aged 25-Year Neglected Grocery Freezer (Burned-Out Frame Heater, Deformed Gasket, -22°C)
freezerEnclosures.description: Critically hazardous installation: frame heater wire has open-circuit fault, frost bridges form within 12 minutes of door closure, and safety escape plunger has broken guide sleeve.

latchMechanisms.name: Kason SafeGuard Glow-in-the-Dark Push-Plunger (Heated Sleeve, Rated 100% Release)
latchMechanisms.type: Internal Spring-Loaded Plunger with Photoluminescent Knob
latchMechanisms.description: ANSI/NSF certified safety release system; pushes external latch bolt open even if exterior handle is padlocked through a safety slot designed to clear lock shackle.

latchMechanisms.name: Standard Unheated Steel Through-Door Push Rod (Vulnerable to Bore-Hole Frost Seizure)
latchMechanisms.type: Solid Stainless Steel Through-Bore Rod with Mushroom Knob
latchMechanisms.iceSeizureSusceptibility: Moderate to High (Thermal Bridge Freezes Moisture Inside Wall Sleeve)
latchMechanisms.description: Metallic conduction along the solid steel rod draws heat from outside, creating heavy condensation inside the door penetration sleeve that freezes the rod solid if unoperated for >4 hours.

latchMechanisms.name: Defective Plunger with Fractured Nylon Shear Pin (Spins Freely Without Actuating Latch)
latchMechanisms.description: Lethal hazard: internal plunger rod pin has sheared during prior panicky impact. Knob moves inward smoothly but fails to exert mechanical force on exterior latch strike.

latchMechanisms.name: External Heavy-Duty Master Lock Hasp (Zero Internal Release Override Mechanism)
latchMechanisms.description: Criminal OSHA violation: exterior door is locked with an aftermarket padlock hasp that mechanically immobilizes the entire door leaf, rendering all internal safety hardware useless.

doorHeaterConditions.name: Active Perimeter Heat Trace (10 W/ft, Frame Temp +18°C, Zero Frost Bridging)
doorHeaterConditions.description: Continuous electric resistance heat trace prevents condensation along the magnetic gasket seal line; door opens effortlessly with standard ~45 N pull force.

doorHeaterConditions.name: Degraded / Partial Resistance Fault Heat Trace (3 W/ft, Frame Temp +1°C, Slush Ring)
doorHeaterConditions.description: Partial element burnout leaves cold spots along the lower perimeter and sill, producing hard rime ice that increases initial breakaway force to 180–320 N.

doorHeaterConditions.name: Burned-Out / Tripped Heat Trace Circuit (0 W/ft, Frame Temp -14°C, Glacial Freeze-Weld)
doorHeaterConditions.description: Heater is completely de-energized; condensation from opening cycles solidifies into a structural ice bond between gasket, stainless face, and latch keeper (breakaway force >750 N).

pressureReliefVentStates.name: Dual-Port Heated Pressure Relief Vent (Active 25W Element, Rapid 3-Second Equalization)
pressureReliefVentStates.description: Two-way heated valve prevents atmospheric pressure differential upon door closure, allowing immediate egress even 5 seconds after door latching.

pressureReliefVentStates.name: Frost-Occluded / Frozen Shut Pressure Relief Port (Vacuum Trapped up to 12 Minutes)
pressureReliefVentStates.description: Negative pressure vacuum pulls door violently against gasket. At 1,450 Pa differential, external atmospheric pressure exerts over 630 lbs (2,800 N) of inward force, defeating manual escape.

occupantAttireProfiles.name: Light Short-Sleeve Chef Coat & Apron (Insulation: 0.55 clo, High Thermal Leakage)
occupantAttireProfiles.description: Standard indoor commercial kitchen line uniform; offers negligible insulation against -20°C ambient cold and zero wind chill shielding.

occupantAttireProfiles.name: Line Cook Heavy Cotton Hoodie & Kitchen Pants (Insulation: 1.10 clo, Moderate Protection)
occupantAttireProfiles.description: Typical back-of-house cold-room runner attire; prolongs survival window but provides no waterproof frost barrier or extremity defense.

occupantAttireProfiles.name: Certified Sub-Zero Industrial Freezer Suit & Thermal Boots (Insulation: 3.20 clo, Full PPE)
occupantAttireProfiles.description: Full OSHA-recommended cold storage suit with insulated balaclava, mittens, and boots; provides multiple hours of metabolic thermal equilibrium.
